title: Superstitiously
summary: SUPERSTI'TIOUSLY, adverb In a superstitious manner; with excessive regard to uncommanded rites or unessential opinions and forms in religion. 1. With too much care; with excessive exactness or scruple

inlines.v: SUPERSTI'TIOUSLY, adverb In a superstitious manner; with excessive regard to uncommanded rites or unessential opinions and forms in religion. 1. With too much care; with excessive exactness or scruple. 2. With extreme credulity in regard to the agency of superior beings in extraordinary events.
